description: This file defines the 'TwoFactorService' interface, which specifies methods related to two-factor authentication processes such as generating OTP tokens, creating access tokens, and validation-related operations within the security infrastructure of the application.

classes.name: TwoFactorService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for handling two-factor authentication operations such as token creation, validation, and retrieval for users.

methods.name: getDeliveryMethodsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves the list of OTP delivery methods available for a specific user.

methods.name: createNewOTPToken
methods.description: Creates a new OTP token for a user, with specified delivery method and optional extended access.

methods.name: createAccessTokenFromOTP
methods.description: Creates an access token based on a provided OTP token for the user.

methods.name: validateTwoFactorAccessToken
methods.description: Validates a two-factor authentication access token for a user.

methods.name: fetchAccessTokenForUser
methods.description: Fetches an existing access token for a user based on a token string.

methods.name: invalidateAccessToken
methods.description: Invalidates a user's access token based on the provided command.
